name: Forecastable
description:
Forecastable is a co-sell orchestration platform that turns partner ecosystems into pipeline your CRO can forecast and your CFO can defend. This connector brings your Forecastable workspace into Claude, so you can plan, execute, and measure partner motions where you already work.

Most partner software manages relationships. Forecastable executes them. A PRM records activity that already happened, and overlap tools show you where partners intersect your accounts. Forecastable builds, deploys, and attributes the partner sales plays that produce pipeline.

What you can do:

Accounts and partners: Look up and update accounts, partners, contacts, and buying groups. Build and maintain relationship maps for target accounts.

Partner plans: Create and track joint plans, goals, milestones, and tasks, so every partner commitment has an owner and a date.

Pipeline: Create and update leads and opportunities, and see the partner activity behind them.

Engagement analytics: Review communication analytics across partner accounts to see which relationships are active, which have gone quiet, and what needs attention.

Outreach: Build Engage lists, templates, and campaign drafts, review the send queue, and read replies. Claude never sends on your behalf. Drafts load into Forecastable, where a user reviews, approves, and sends them from the platform.

Meetings: Pull calendar events, transcripts, summaries, and logged action items from partner calls, then route those action items into the right plan.

Example prompts:

"Which partner relationships have gone quiet this quarter?"
"Summarize yesterday's partner call and turn the action items into tasks."
"What partner commitments are overdue this week?"

Built for partnership leaders, partner managers, and revenue teams running co-sell motions. Requires a Forecastable account. Access follows your Forecastable permissions, and all outbound communication requires human approval inside Forecastable.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Forecastable to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Forecastable to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://app.forecastable.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Forecastable MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Forecastable lists 108 MCP tools, including addEngageListMembers, bulkCreateAccounts, bulkCreateEngageCampaigns, createAccount, createAccountContact, createEngageCampaign, createEngageDraft, createEngageList, createEngageTemplate, createLead, createOpportunity, and createPlan.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Forecastable?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Forecastable in sales-and-marketing on the Manufact MCP catalog include Griddo AX Docs, Rocket Sloth, Affonso.io, Datacircle, and Tolt.
Forecastable requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Forecastable is developed by Forecastable, Inc.. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
